overview: 103 official Qs (2008: 32, 2012: 3, 2017: 15, 2019: 26, 2025: 27). Mostly one-liners (75 with options, 18 stem-only); 2025 added 5 matching, 2 A-R, a two-statement and a chronology Q. Nationalist movement (29) and socio-cultural awakening (19) lead; 'who founded/led/wrote' and 'which year' are the staple. 2 Qs deleted.

possibility.angle: Advent of Europeans (first factories, settlements, persons, introductions)
possibility.what_they_ask: Where a power set up its first Andhra factory, French/Dutch settlement, year EIC founded, who commanded which ship, Blue Water policy, Portuguese crops
Port → activity (textiles, shipbuilding), ruler who permitted a factory

possibility.angle: Andhra under the Company (Circars, revolts, land revenue, famine, taxes)
possibility.what_they_ask: Battle year, where Ryotwari began, poligar rebel, 1879 Rampa place, worst famine, tax meaning, chronology of Company events, first Principal Collector
Town where revolt was attempted (Kadapa); A-R on why Andhra was little affected

possibility.angle: Establishment of British rule (Circars lease, Padmanabham, subsidiary alliance, officials, industry)
possibility.what_they_ask: Who mediated the Circars lease, which state first signed subsidiary alliance, who fought Padmanabham, officials behind schools/anicut, manganese district

possibility.angle: Socio-cultural awakening (Veeresalingam, journals, firsts, missionaries, education, Hyderabad institutions)
possibility.what_they_ask: Founder of a journal/samaj/school, exact year/date of firsts, first printed book/novel/dictionary, author of a book, founding years of colleges
Its aim, seats in 1920, university it helped found
Natural targets, judged from the Justice Party Qs: founder and year (Periyar, 1925), its anti-caste aims, Andhra rationalist links such as Tripuraneni Ramaswamy (Kaviraju)

possibility.angle: Nationalist movement 1885–1947 (Vandemataram, NCM, CDM/salt, Quit India, Hyderabad State politics)
possibility.what_they_ask: Who led which local agitation, dictator of salt satyagraha, year/month of events, organisations and founding years, titles (Andhra Sivaji), volunteer corps, Alluri's first raid
Year of Andhra unit, its first president/secretary
Odd person (non-communist), year of ban, author of a memoir/history
Pioneer of kisan movement, place of first kisan school, local anti-zamindari leaders

possibility.angle: Nationalist poetry, revolutionary literature and Nataka samasthalu
possibility.what_they_ask: Author of a song/lyric, book containing a song, poet's title, author–book matching, proscribed drama author
Natural targets, judged from how leaders are asked: Durgabai Deshmukh (Andhra Mahila Sabha 1937), Duvvuri Subbamma, Ponaka Kanakamma – 'who led/founded' one-liners

traps.fix: Anchor the exact year: widow remarriage 11 Dec 1881 (association 1880); Nizam College 1887; Osmania 1918
traps.pyq: 'first widow remarriage' → 1881, 1880 is the association year [mains-2017-paper2#41]; 'Osmania University' → 1918 [group2-2008-paper2#61]

traps.trap: Leader of one local agitation offered for another
traps.spot: Chirala-Perala, Pedanandipadu, Palnadu, Rampa leaders listed together
traps.fix: Chirala-Perala = Duggirala (Ramadandu); Pedanandipadu = Parvataneni (Andhra Sivaji); Palnadu pullari = Kanneganti Hanumanthu
traps.pyq: 'leader of Chirala Perala' → Duggirala, P.V. Choudary is Pedanandipadu [mains-2025-paper1#70]

traps.spot: Stem names one battle; options carry the parties of the other
traps.fix: Bobbili 1757 = French (Bussy) + Vizianagaram vs Bobbili; Padmanabham 1794 = English vs Vizianagaram (Vijaya Rama Raju)
traps.pyq: 'Padmanabha battle was fought between' → English and Vizianagaram, not French and Bobbili [mains-2025-paper1#63]

traps.trap: First European factory confused with later HQ or another power
traps.fix: Dutch first at Machilipatnam 1605, Pulicat 1610; English first at Machilipatnam 1611; French settlement = Yanam
traps.pyq: 'Dutch first factory in Andhra' → Machilipatnam, not Pulicat [mains-2017-paper2#36]

traps.trap: Wrong commander/person inside a true event
traps.spot: A-R where the event and year are right but the person is swapped
traps.fix: Globe at Machilipatnam 1611 = Captain Hippon; Hawkins went to Surat/Jahangir 1608
traps.pyq: 'Globe under Captain Hawkins arrived at Machilipatnam' → A false [mains-2025-paper1#31]

traps.spot: Two-statement Q defining Company-era revenue terms
traps.fix: Moturpha = tax on trades, professions and looms (not salt); Peshkash = tribute from zamindars

traps.trap: First printed book vs first novel vs first dictionary
traps.fix: First printed Telugu book = Bible (Schultze translation 1746-47); first novel = Rajasekhara Charitramu (1878)
traps.pyq: 'first book printed in Telugu' → the Bible, Rajasekhara Charitra is the first novel [group2-2008-paper2#17]

traps.trap: A-R where R concerns a different territory
traps.spot: Reason about the Nizam explains an assertion about Madras-Presidency Andhra
traps.fix: Check whether R and A refer to the same region before linking
traps.pyq: 1857: A (Andhra little affected) and R (Nizam pro-British) both true, R not the explanation [mains-2025-paper1#26]

traps.fix: Ryotwari began in Baramahal (1792); Circars got the zamindari settlement; Munro = first Principal Collector of Ceded Districts

techniques.name: Event-ladder chronology
techniques.how: Pin each event to a year [Guntur 1788, Padmanabham 1794, Madras ryotwari 1820, zamindari abolition 1948]; order the ladder and match ends.

techniques.name: Two-pair lock for matching
techniques.how: Lock the two pairs you are surest of, keep only codes with both, verify one more.
techniques.example: Mahaprasthanam – Sri Sri and Kanyasulkam – Gurajada → codes with b-ii, c-i → Veyipadagalu – Viswanatha decides → 'a-v, b-ii, c-i, d-iv' [mains-2025-paper1#55]; Ramadandu – Duggirala, Kaviraju – Tripuraneni → 'a-iii, b-i, c-ii, d-iv' [mains-2025-paper1#54]

techniques.name: Odd-one-out by camp
techniques.how: Tag each person by party/camp (Communist, State Congress, Socialist); the single different tag is the answer.
techniques.example: Ravi Narayana Reddy, Baddam Yella Reddy, Alwar Swamy = Communists; Ramananda Tirtha = State Congress [group2-2008-paper2#1]

techniques.name: Period filter on institutions
techniques.how: Drop options founded after the period of the body asked about.
techniques.example: Justice Party (1920-37): Telugu University 1985, SVU 1954, Padmavati 1983 fall → Andhra University [mains-2025-paper1#51]

techniques.name: Function test for the official
techniques.how: Recall what each Briton is known for (Brown – Vemana/dictionary, Mackenzie – manuscripts, Munro – ryotwari, Cotton – anicut); match to the verb in the stem.
techniques.example: 'collected the poems of Vemana' → C.P. Brown; Mackenzie collected kaifiyats [group2-2008-paper2#70]

techniques.name: Role-in-movement check
techniques.how: Distinguish the overall dictator from local breakers of law and from the Madras leader.
techniques.example: Salt satyagraha Andhra dictator → Konda Venkatappayya; Prakasam led at Madras [mains-2017-paper2#49]

Hyderabad first to sign subsidiary alliance, 1798
Guntur famine 1833 – most serious; led to Cotton's Godavari anicut (helped by Veeranna)

Veeresalingam: Viveka Vardhini 1874, Prarthana Samaj 1878, first widow remarriage 11 Dec 1881
Bipin Chandra Pal's Andhra tour April 1907 (Bala Bharati Samiti at Rajahmundry); Kotappakonda Feb 1909, Tenali bomb April 1909
Pingali Venkaiah flag model 1921; Alluri's first raid Chintapalli 1922
Salt satyagraha 1930: Konda Venkatappayya dictator; Kakinada – Bulusu Sambamurti, Masulipatnam – Pattabhi
Andhra Socialist Party 1934 – first president N.G. Ranga; Ranga's first kisan school at Nidubrolu

checklist: Is the stem asking first, founder, leader, author or year? Note the role word.
For a year Q, recall the event's anchor and its neighbours (association vs act, idea vs founding).
Name the local agitation and its district before matching a leader.
Separate the European powers: Portuguese, Dutch, English, French – first factory vs later HQ.
In A-R, check A and R refer to the same region and person before linking.
Matching: lock two sure pairs, then verify the third.
